text: Materials science is a comprehensive discipline that studies the relationships among the composition, structure, preparation process and properties of materials. Its core lies in designing and optimizing the microstructure of materials to develop new types of materials that meet specific functional requirements, providing fundamental support for industrial manufacturing, energy, information, and biomedical fields. From commonly used plastics and metals to high-temperature-resistant alloys for aerospace, semiconductor materials in chips, the research achievements of materials science permeate every aspect of human production and life, and are hailed as "the cornerstone of industry" and "the forerunner of high-tech".
